fields.value: Strain-Modulated Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange over Au-Pd Core-Shell Nanocatalysts

dsDescriptionValue.value:
This dataset contains raw catalytic data, the High Resolution Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (HR-STEM) images and the raw 4D-STEM data used in the publication: "Strain-Modulated Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange over Au-Pd Core-Shell Nanocatalysts " (https://doi.org/10.1021/acscatal.6c02868). 

The data is organized in two folders: 
               >> Catalytic tests <<
This folder contains subfolders containing the different catalytic tests, labeled with the corresponding Pd layer thickness. Each folder contains log files (Log_1L.txt) with the temperature and flow data, and an excel file (.xls) containing raw Mass Spectrometry (MS) data.
               >> EM data <<
This folder contains the electron microscopy data. The data is organized in two subfolders: 4D-STEM and HR-STEM. The HR-STEM folder contains the images, sorted by layer thickness, which were used to extract lattice parameters. The 4D-STEM folder contains ADF image, Diffraction SI (4D-STEM dataset) and strain maps in x and y direction (Strain Exx, Strain Eyy).
